approval.description: Provides the framework for user approval.

ask_user.description: Provides the AskUser tool: the model puts one decision to the operator with a list of options, each able to carry a preview of example content, and waits for the answer. Answered by whichever ask: adapter session.approval names.

ast_grep.description: Provides the AstGrep tool: structural code search over the syntax tree, through the ast-grep binary. Needs ast-grep on PATH and reports how to install it when absent.

commands.description: Allows slash commands, both the built-in ones and any authored as .un/commands/<name>.md.

file_system.description: Allows agents to interact with the filesystem (read, write, edit, grep, glob).

git_read_only.description: Provides the read-only git tool. Raw git stays unavailable, unless git_read_only is set to false in config.toml.

hooks.description: Registers hooks dropped into .un/hooks/, each declaring its event and its script in frontmatter and activated by a [hooks.<name>] table in config.toml.

init.description: Initializes the project dir, creates default files, etc.

interactive.description: Allows the interactive loop with an agent.

learning.description: Notes where in a session record something worth keeping might be, and runs the background pass that produces those notes. Writes a worklist, never a memory or a skill.

memory.description: Provides agent memory and memory management.

models.description: Reports how full the context window is and what the session has cost, from a per-model table of context windows and per-token prices that a [models."<name>"] block in config.toml may extend.

oauth.description: Provides `un login`, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE against any issuer another plugin registers as an oauth: service. Registers no issuer itself.

openai_api.description: Provides OpenAI-compatible API integration - OpenAI, ollama, and anything else speaking the same wire format.

permissions.description: Enforces the tool permission table. Cannot be disabled.

rules.description: Allows user defined 'rules', more like instructions with triggers.

session_transcripts.description: Provides the mechanism for sessions to be written to file.

session_view.description: Renders the full session record from the transcript and puts it on screen in place of the conversation, toggled with ctrl-t. Shows what the conversation view drops: the system prompt, thinking blocks, hook fires, permission verdicts and usage rows.

shell_access.description: Allows shell access and Bash tools (grep, cat, ls, etc).

skills.description: Allows agent skills, and lets the agent author its own under .un/skills/.

subagents.description: Registers the Task tool and the subagents defined as .un/agents/**/*.md.

themes.description: Provides a theme capability for the CLI and the REPL.

workflows.description: Runs workflows: Python that drives the agent with exit-code gates, from .un/workflows/.
